findings.evidence: aria-invalid='true' on #promo; error text in #s3-form-promo-error ('Enter a 6 character code using letters and numbers only.'); no aria-describedby attribute on input linking to error text
findings.violation: The input is marked with aria-invalid='true' but is not programmatically associated with its error description, so assistive-technology users cannot connect the field's invalid state to the explanation of what is wrong.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby='s3-form-promo-error' to the input element to associate it with its error message.
